Body.Content:
Azure Blueprints, currently in preview, enables the creation of fully governed environments in a repetitive manner. Use Azure Blueprints to:

  • Deploy resources, policies, and RBAC repetitively.
  • Configure new subscriptions at scale.
  • Ensure fully compliant development environments in minutes.
  • Create full environments that are ready for migrations.
  • Lock foundational resources across environments.

Learn more.
